objective.text: Use a dedicated read projection when a report has different data requirements from transactional model writes.

difficulty.rationale: Choose a representation for a report without weakening transactional model semantics.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: A report needs monthly totals per currency, not editable order rows. Existing Order models implement write invariants and are used elsewhere.

stem: Which design supplies that report without changing what an Order instance represents?

options.text: Remove Order’s invariants so both aggregate and ordinary rows can share it.
options.rationale: That weakens unrelated write behavior merely to accommodate a read representation.
options.misconception: That weakens unrelated write behavior merely to accommodate a read representation.

options.text: Add a physical order row for every monthly total and include it in ordinary order queries.
options.rationale: Mixing summary rows with transactional orders changes their meaning and risks counting summaries as source data.
options.misconception: Mixing summary rows with transactional orders changes their meaning and risks counting summaries as source data.

options.text: Use a dedicated aggregate query and report result DTO, leaving Order writes on their existing path.
options.rationale: The report’s grouped rows have a different shape and purpose; a separate read representation avoids pretending they are editable orders.

options.text: Hydrate monthly totals as Order objects and reuse their save method for report rows.
options.rationale: Grouped totals do not represent individual persisted orders and cannot safely use those write semantics.
options.misconception: Grouped totals do not represent individual persisted orders and cannot safely use those write semantics.
